readiness.hed: No active NWS alerts for Fredericksburg; a few showers possible before 2 p.m., then a dry, cool start to the week.
readiness.insight: NWS lists no active alerts at the Fredericksburg point. Today is cloudy with a 30 percent chance of showers before 2 p.m., under a tenth of an inch, and a high near 68, so allow a little extra time on wet roads to church. Tonight is mostly cloudy with a low near 50. Monday and Tuesday are sunny, with highs in the mid- to upper 60s and lows near 40, so the furnace or an extra blanket may get its first use.
